title: Dual-expert (DSConv Expert A) + mean↔LSE pooling + BiGRU(160), scalar gate + post-norm + grad-clip=1.0 — seed=42 (retry)
abstract: Retry DSConv dual-expert with global-norm gradient clipping (1.0) after fixing kernel_dilation API. Tests whether clipping improves PRS/CRI stability.
